description: List magic strings that resolve to no real entity — the inverse of list_unused, and the safety net after a move/rename (target: 0). Skips unverifiable external-plugin refs. Use after apply_edits to confirm nothing was left dangling.

from.description: A path inside the target project (e.g. the file you are editing). Disambiguates a multi-project workspace.

project.description: A project name (its folder) or root path. Use when you have no file path in hand.

name: list_broken_refs
title: Find references that point at nothing
